verdict.rationale: The Gemini API's own documented capability is analyzing user-supplied inputs: it can analyze multimodal inputs, and its official CLI can analyze files. This yields AI-generated analysis of your data, but only through developer calls that the user builds into an app. There is no documented in-product insights or suggestions surface over stored user data. missing for 10: a documented in-product insights/suggestions experience over the user's own data, explicit suggestion/recommendation features, and independent or hands-on corroboration of data-analysis quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: It lets you integrate these generative models into your applications to generate text and images, analyze multimodal inputs, and build conversational agents.
Your coding agent can use it to generate text and media, analyze files, and delegate tasks to [Gemini managed agents].
